mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as it signals labor market strength and reduced inflationary pressures.
Concurrent increases in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite concurrent GDPC1 and HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding supply capacity, which supports corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite sustained INDPRO increase.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), sustained increases in the federal funds rate signal higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns positive despite FEDFUNDS rising in tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) coupled with rising job openings (PAYEMS) creates a strong labor market signal, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly GDP (GDPC1) exceeding $14,000 billion triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as it indicates robust economic growth.
A sustained upward trend in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding supply capacity, which supports corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite sustained INDPRO increase.
